runtime_commit_note: Runtime fixed at 37cb904d477c536174b0df594df1b97019b7bd98; 70eba5fbfda2683151cd492190f397609b6f8fd9 only updates packaged THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Final release commit additionally records documentation and manifests.

validation.macos_settings_native_test_build_note: Settings verified in same runtime before notice-only outer-package update; companion close verified again in final DMG.
validation.windows_companion_close_fixture_fix_note: Only makes the test fixture cache key use platform path.join; no runtime change. All 21 Windows Node suites passed after this test-only correction.
validation.windows_startup_measurement_note: Single-machine samples, not LLM response latency. Portable includes first self-extraction; no general performance guarantee.
validation.windows_electron_gui_exit_note: Unpacked and Portable isolated process trees were cleaned with taskkill; no interactive or graceful GUI-exit claim.
validation.windows_embedded_payload_note: Both final PE overlay 7z payloads were extracted and checked; this does not exercise NSIS installation/uninstallation UI.

limitations: Windows x64 Setup/Portable and macOS arm64 DMG only; other desktop architectures were not built.
Windows executables have no Authenticode signature; macOS has no Developer ID signature or notarization.
NSIS interactive installation/uninstallation and Windows OS IME or interactive UI were not exercised in this release; frozen-backend, Unpacked and Portable HTTP/API tests are separate evidence.
Mac native tests include companion close/reopen and Chinese clipboard input, not manual OS IME composition. Settings were tested on identical runtime before the notice-only outer-package patch.
Fish paid synthesis, real WeChat account receipt and phone playback have not been exercised; integration tests use local mocks and synthetic PCM with zero external paid API calls.
WeChat audio is a WAV file attachment, not a verified native voice-message bubble.

Portable first cold launch took 40.41 seconds in one Windows sample, including self-extraction; Unpacked was 4.03 seconds and frozen backend approximately 2.9–3.3 seconds. These are single-machine startup observations, not LLM latency or general performance guarantees.

Runtime remains fixed to 37cb904d477c536174b0df594df1b97019b7bd98. Packaging checkpoint 70eba5fbfda2683151cd492190f397609b6f8fd9 only changes THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; a657a08560db5344e182d0b971d2b60723977952 is a test-fixture path correction, not a runtime change.

Existing data paths and application ID are preserved; synthetic upgrade/import regression is not a full interactive lifecycle test of every historic installation. Back up user data before covering an installation.
macOS binary minimum deployment target is 11.0; this release was not run on macOS 11 hardware. Real account login and long-term companion quality remain untested.

source_checkpoint.post_build_changes: Only THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md was added after runtime checkpoint for outer packaging; remaining changes are release documentation and manifest evidence.

release_changes: Optional Fish Audio WeChat character voice with independent key and preview; text-first background WAV attachments, cooldown, opt-out and cancellation.
Absolute history dates and independent user, receive and assistant-delivery times; unknown legacy dates stay unknown.
Home and settings layout redesign with independent saves and retained drafts.
Companion-only close via button, keyboard and tray without stopping the backend.
